key_insight: A guide-grounded multimodal LLM that combines ECG images, Grad-CAM, CNN outputs, and curated interpretation guidelines can generate more clinically aligned ECG explanations than baseline multimodal prompting.
clinical_relevance: This approach may improve trustworthiness and reproducibility of AI-generated ECG reports by reducing hallucinations and anchoring explanations in established diagnostic criteria.
method: CNN analyzes 12-lead ECG images and produces class probabilities.
Grad-CAM generates class-specific heatmaps for visual explanation.
A distilled ECG Interpretation Guide is injected as fixed knowledge for the multimodal LLM to generate structured reports.
evidence_signal: On the full PTB-XL test set, the method improved average BERTScore for impressions from 0.818 to 0.953 versus a strong CNN+Grad-CAM+MLLM baseline, while maintaining competitive classification performance.
watch_item: Performance gains on benchmark data do not guarantee safe real-world deployment, and the fixed guide must be carefully curated and maintained to avoid outdated or biased criteria.
paper_title: Enhancing Explainable Cardiac Diagnosis with Guide-Grounded Multimodal LLMs
